channel.title: Bins-USA Blog
channel.description: Practical ideas for organising a Shopify warehouse.

item.title: How to organise a small Shopify warehouse
item.description: Somebody with a spare room or a unit, boxes on the floor, and no system. What to name shelves, how granular to go, and when bins start paying off.

item.title: Bin naming that still makes sense at 400 bins
item.description: Aisle-rack-shelf schemes, why sequential numbers fall apart, and how to leave room to grow.

item.title: Five things that slow down picking
item.description: Walking order, one product in several bins, no barcode, batching, and printing the list too late.

item.title: Cycle counting without closing for a day
item.description: Counting a few bins a week instead of everything at once, which bins to start with, and what to do with the differences.

item.title: Shopify locations are not bins
item.description: What Shopify tracks, what it does not, and why quantity without position is only half an inventory.

item.title: Receiving a pallet without losing an afternoon
item.description: Scanning into a bin as you unload, when to label, and why the fast path is one bin at a time.

item.title: Finding the stock that is not moving
item.description: How dead stock hides in a warehouse, what 90 days of no movement really costs, and what to do about it.

item.title: What your warehouse staff should not see
item.description: Costs, margins and payouts on a shared tablet, and how to give someone the picking screen and nothing else.
